description: This file contains command-line interface commands related to managing a launchd agent for the Swabble application, including installing, uninstalling, and checking the status of the launch agent.

classes.name: ServiceRootCommand
classes.description: Defines the root command for managing the service with subcommands.

classes.name: ServiceInstall
classes.description: Handles the installation of the launch agent.

classes.name: ServiceUninstall
classes.description: Handles the removal of the launch agent.

classes.name: ServiceStatus
classes.description: Displays the status of the launch agent.

methods.name: writePlist
methods.description: Creates and writes a plist file for launchd to launch the service.

methods.name: removePlist
methods.description: Removes the launchd plist file if it exists.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the command's main logic for install, uninstall, or status.
